notes.title: Stonks Market Crashes 40% - New Low Price!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40225894/b85d47e85375478bdf98b85a0179b2df4441ba93.png[/img]

Attention investors!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554080][b]The Stonks Market[/b][/url] has suffered a tremendous loss in value overnight, dropping [b]40%[/b] of its price at open this morning. It's reached a new all-time low of [b]$2.99 USD[/b] and it's uncertain whether it will ever recover.

While this deflation is an unwelcome shock to those with long positions, new traders must ask themselves if this is the dip they were waiting to buy. Value investors, take note! This could be the deal of the century.

notes.title: The Stonks Market - Version 050
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40225894/4e249c7356ca92252fe3987e3059301f8c85249c.png[/img]
Hey Stonkers,
We made some changes to the trading interface, the market fluctuations, and some other things whjch should reveal more information through play. A lot of this has come from user feedback in the Discord and watching folks play on Twitch.

Thanks for playing the game, and we hope you enjoy it even more!

[h2]Version 050[/h2]
- Per-stock cost average is now displayed in the detailed information panel
- Individual stock gain / loss percentage is now displayed in the detailed information panel
- Portfolio daily change value and percentage now displayed in the portfolio information panel
- Improved data layout for better readability
- Added qty +/- 10 buttons for easier order manipulation
- Added ZERO button to easily reset your qty counter
- Applied visual button highlights to give better confirmation feedback
- Now plays sound effects on Buy / Sell confirmations
- Changed the sound effect for the finale's quit button denial
- Provide player detail on the exactness of their market effect in the finale
- Rejig the finale structure (Golden Boom now more difficult to reach)
- Improved number rounding display to always show double decimals
- Fixed some typos
- Other stuff

notes.title: Stonks Update - Version 048
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40225894/882dda0ce545973cdd19df41517068d0e12fefe1.png[/img]

Just a few small changes to the way the numbers work behind the scenes, and a little extra data fed to the player at the end of the game. Nothing too exciting, but improves stability and market functions.

Sorry, Linux users.

[b]Version 048[/b]
- Lowered floors during finale to 0.01
- Fixed variance on bad market days (more chaos)
- Improved market systems / stability overall
- Added some game data read-outs after final trades
- Tracked all-time peak portfolio value metric
- Added alternative closing song on finale day
- Disabled Linux build until further notice
- Fixed some video playback issues
- Updated Steam library artwork

notes.title: Welcome to The Stonks Market
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/25fe395ca8e9c8e3e697ed2ac9d78971433d623f.png[/img]

[i]How's your portfolio doing?[/i]

Today we're pleased to release [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554080]The Stonks Market[/url][/b], right here on Steam. It's a simple trading simulator with a funny story about a rather clueless guy who gets into all kinds of trouble through the stock market.

You'll get access to a basic trading terminal, a stimulus check, and enough time to risk it all gambling on bad plays you've barely researched. All of this while you contend with a frustrated wife, too many know-it-all advisors, and the crippling fear of losing it all in an instant. Kinda like real-life, huh?

 [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/e5897f78b0550828efc32164b8e789b89a33d162.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/7dd5875707b4d4bf76c798b20bfecfcd38f8fc12.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/4f361d8313e12f7becca7bfedcb7903ee21b75e1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/886ee68add5c804f1bd88f273316353a8fd26473.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/4939a247b3b956d695b042d49d869b7ee4143e98.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/06a8eb6883f9f8f57763dd68d1404ea119e79da5.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/9683675a3db573cc8d09c196b6eb46b113537c2e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/c8711d7cb90376669f022f459fd119df39f7f9f4.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/98343e79c7032f572fc88d8a8d9d1e9bfd5801ae.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38521136/f691051397262966098218cde1f56dd70e15fcfe.png[/img][/url]

Whether you're an avid stock bro, a crayon-eating monkey, or never touched a trading app in your life, [b]The Stonks Market[/b] is worth a few laughs. We hope you enjoy all its wild characters and bizarre scenarios.
